summary: Design code boundaries and domain models before large structural change.

skills.choose_when: The task concerns module boundaries, dependency direction, modularization, or architecture migration.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use for a small localized implementation with no structural decision.
skills.name: design-codebase

skills.choose_when: Business concepts, invariants, state transitions, or bounded contexts need explicit modeling.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use for directory organization without domain-rule ambiguity.
skills.name: model-domain

skills.choose_when: An API contract, OpenAPI description, public interface, versioning policy, or compatibility promise needs design review before or alongside implementation.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use for debugging one handler, reviewing an ordinary code diff, or merely documenting an already-fixed private function.
skills.name: review-api-design
